pillars.desc: Keeping students aware — of opportunities, technologies, schemes and everything happening in the innovation ecosystem.
Going deeper than headlines — speaker sessions, mentorship and honest conversations with people who've built things.
Turning awareness into ideas — brainstorms, hackathons and pitch events where raw thoughts become concepts.
Testing what's real — validating ideas, building prototypes, and learning from what breaks.
Shipping — seed funding, incubation and institutional support to take validated ideas into the real world.
